build_metrics_aggregator: build a metrics aggregator for the Nevis stream using nevis_metrics with a dataset lookup and writer
create_predictions_writer: create a WrappedPredictionsWriter context manager to buffer and save raw predictions to an npz file
compute_single_label_results: compute weighted and average single label accuracy from a sequence of PredictionMetrics objects
compute_multi_label_results: compute the average multi label mean average precision from a sequence of PredictionMetrics objects
compute_stream_results: compute final normalized accuracy and mAP statistics over the Nevis metrics stream state
